levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة

notes: Narrated encounter (owner ruling 5): the father relates «رَأَيْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ يَعْمَلُ»; the Imam then speaks («فَقَالَ يَا عَلِيُّ عَمِلَ بِالْيَدِ»), so he is the last link after the narrator.
The Imam's later words about the Prophet and the Commander of the Faithful are part of his reply, not new links.
